integrity.mathematical_evidence: Complete five-complex finite discrete-Morse face-poset acyclicity certificates and a separately implemented finite-field simplicial-chain check; the integral homotopy proof uses verified acyclic matchings.
integrity.unproved_limits: No assertion about arbitrary-size graph families, geometric actions on homotopy, or independent external certification.

scientific_limitations: Applies only to the eight-vertex Wagner graph and its edge-orbit deletion/link complexes. No formula for larger Moebius ladders; indexed literature inspection cannot rule out unindexed equivalent sources.
title: The Wagner graph matching complex and its two edge-orbit splittings
